scope.feature: Dispatch plunder public schedule/cancel contract and internal persistence kernel

scheduleRandomization.effectiveDelaySeconds: uniform integer 0..min(configured max, floor((taskExpireTime-plunderAt-1)/1000) when expiry positive, floor((2^53-1-plunderAt)/1000)); lower bounded at 0

invalidRow.message: secret task scheduling data is invalid

rowPredicate: uuid is a nonempty JSON string containing only ASCII decimal digits
scheduleRecovery.numericAccessor: same recovered integer-like accessor used by R7-046; numeric values and signed decimal numeric strings are accepted, invalid/missing maps to 0

predicate: taskUuid is a nonempty JSON string containing only ASCII decimal digits

invalidTarget.message: server ID and secret task UUID are required

recoveredSql.schedule: INSERT INTO dispatch_plunder_jobs(server_id,task_uuid,task_json,completion_time,plunder_at,expire_at,status,attempts,last_error,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (?1,?2,?3,?4,?5,?6,'scheduled',0,NULL,?7,?7) ON CONFLICT(server_id,task_uuid) DO UPDATE SET task_json=excluded.task_json,completion_time=excluded.completion_time,plunder_at=excluded.plunder_at,expire_at=excluded.expire_at,updated_at=excluded.updated_at WHERE dispatch_plunder_jobs.status IN ('scheduled','waiting_connection')
recoveredSql.scheduleReadback: SELECT task_json,status,attempts,last_error,created_at,updated_at FROM dispatch_plunder_jobs WHERE server_id=?1 AND task_uuid=?2
recoveredSql.cancel: UPDATE dispatch_plunder_jobs SET status='cancelled',last_error=NULL,updated_at=?3 WHERE server_id=?1 AND task_uuid=?2 AND status IN ('scheduled','waiting_connection')

persistenceSemantics.activeReschedule: only scheduled/waiting_connection rows are updated; task_json/completion_time/plunder_at/expire_at/updated_at change while status/attempts/last_error/created_at are preserved
persistenceSemantics.runningOrTerminalConflict: guarded ON CONFLICT update affects no row; schedule is rejected rather than replacing the prior attempt
persistenceSemantics.expireAt: positive taskExpireTime becomes expire_at; nonpositive/missing becomes SQL NULL
persistenceSemantics.cancel: only scheduled/waiting_connection transitions to cancelled; last_error cleared; updated_at replaced

implementation.publicBoundary: Public Dispatch cancel is enabled and emits the recovered change event. Public Dispatch schedule remains unavailable until a current-v19 authoritative executor and durable worker are recovered/implemented.

recoveredWorkerInputsForNextCheckpoint.expireTransition: scheduled/waiting_connection -> expired with DISPATCH_PLUNDER_TASK_EXPIRED when expire_at<=now
recoveredWorkerInputsForNextCheckpoint.armableRead: scheduled/waiting_connection with plunder_at<=now+lead ordered by plunder_at ASC LIMIT 1
recoveredWorkerInputsForNextCheckpoint.statusUpdate: status/error update with optional exactly-one attempt increment
recoveredWorkerInputsForNextCheckpoint.offlineDue: scheduled due and unexpired -> waiting_connection / DISPATCH_PLUNDER_GAME_DISCONNECTED

privacy: Static recovery plus disposable synthetic database tests only. No live player identity, target UUID, coordinates, session identifiers, database, or raw runtime logs are retained.

currentActionBoundary.map_dispatch_plunder_cancel: IMPLEMENTED/OFFLINE-TESTED public local-scheduler cancellation; no gameplay action
